summary: Silver Point Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting two routine events: (1) an unregistered sale of 949,126 common shares at $26.66 per share, raising ~$25.3 million via subscription agreements under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D/S, reflecting an ordinary capital raise by a private credit fund; and (2) declaration of a regular monthly dividend of $0.1575 per share payable in May 2026. Neither event constitutes a special situation — there is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change. The filing is a routine current report of equity sales and dividend declaration.
